title: Nonzero small column sums
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $\ell$ be a positive natural number, and let $\alpha$ assign to each of $n$ column indices a point in the binary extension field of degree $\ell$, injectively. Form the binary Vandermonde matrix from these points. For every nonempty set of at most $k$ columns, the sum of those columns is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ is a natural number other than zero
A point in the binary extension field is specified for each column
The assignment of points to columns is injective
